scoring_justification: Comparison of computed compressibility values to paper-reported approximate values along the isochore, with tolerance absorbing numerical discretization differences, and structural trend bonus.

hidden_assets.purpose: Golden reference table of (Gamma, chi0_over_chi) along the isochore extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Figure 6 and associated text in the paper 'Further investigations into the low-density behaviour of the hypernetted chain equation for ionic fluids' (Molecular Physics, 1992).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Approximate values read from the isochore curves in Figure 6 at ρσ³=0.05, with minor rounding.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results for this isochore, providing a concrete verification target.

outputs.description: Computed inverse isothermal compressibility χ0/χ for the RPM at ρσ³=0.05 as a function of Γ. Used for comparison to hidden reference values and structural trend checks.

output_contract.notes: The solving agent must reimplement the HNC solver and produce this CSV. The hidden checker compares each chi0_over_chi against reference values with a tolerance and verifies monotonic decrease. Only converged state points are required.

steps.description: Per-point comparison of chi0_over_chi to paper's approximate values within 15% relative tolerance.
Verify monotonic decrease in chi0_over_chi with Gamma, and that the ratio of mean of first two to mean of last two points is >= 5.
